Our story

Built to be passed down

It began at a candlelit table in Sweden, at Strålsnäs Herrgård. Good food, family, and a conversation about the Christmases we remembered from childhood.

My mother-in-law has spent her life as a textile teacher, making beautiful things by hand. That night she told me about a dream she’d carried for years: to make Christmas stockings built to last generations.

Every stocking is still handmade by her. No mass production. No shortcuts. Premium materials, original designs, and a limited number each season, because real craftsmanship can’t be rushed.

This was never really about stockings. It’s about Christmas morning, and the traditions that bring us home.
